name: ripwithme

scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler pages dev ./out
scripts.signups:count: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT COALESCE(utm_source, referrer, 'direct') AS source, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM signups GROUP BY source ORDER BY signups DESC"

description: Rip With Me — live one-on-one Pokémon TCG openings. Static Next.js site on Cloudflare Pages, with a Pages Function for the launch list.
